{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''[&hellip;]'' on Belnar, even Khil Jedi are called to ssserve.|Xamar|<ref name="KOTOR 31">[[Knights of the Old Republic 31|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 31]]</ref>}}
'''Belnar''' was a [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. A [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] world with large [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] on its surface, it was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Khil]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Although the Khil developed large, [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]-inspired [[City/Legends|cities]] on Belnar, the rest of the planet was left untouched, and even the urban centers featured marshy parks and swamps. Such areas in the cities served as convenient [[Diet/Legends|feeding]] sites for the Khil, whose diet consisted of organic particles filtered from the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] via [[Hullepi|special organs]].

The Khil of Belnar, who welcomed off-worlders to their planet, were members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from as early as [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]], having had [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperspace travel]] technology of their own for [[25,000 BBY/Legends|three millennia]] by that point. Around [[3643 BBY]], a [[Unidentified Belnar Senator|Republic senator]] from Belnar absconded with an ancient, sacred Khil [[Unidentified artifact (Khil)|artifact]]; however, the item was eventually returned to the natives of the planet. Belnar fell under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]]. The Khil, who viewed the Empire as oppressive, became one of the first members of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] following the Empire's [[Battle of Endor/Legends|fragmentation]].

==Description==
Belnar was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="KOTORCG" /> located in the [[Belnar system/Legends|Belnar system]],<ref name="TEA" /> a part of the [[Belnar sector/Legends|Belnar sector]]<ref name="EAOC Belnar" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. From approximately [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]] to [[3996 BBY]], Belnar was situated on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected it to the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida]] and [[Yabol Opa system/Legends|Yabol Opa systems]]; however, that [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route had ceased to exist [[3976 BBY|twenty years]] later.<ref name="TEA" />

A terrestrial world with no [[Moon/Legends|moons]], Belnar had a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of twenty-three [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] and a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of 347 [[Local day/Legends|local days]]. The planet had standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] and a [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] climate. At one point, the planet was covered by large expanses of marshes and [[Swamp/Legends|swampland]], with several swamps tens of thousands of square miles in area remaining by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Old Sith Wars]] of [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]&ndash;[[3950 BBY]].<ref name="KOTORCG" />

==History==
===Early member of the Republic===
Belnar's native [[Khil]] [[Species/Legends|species]] developed [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperspace travel]] technology by [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]]. Although the area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding Belnar was fully [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]], by that time the planet had already been a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for at least two [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Khil [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Xamar]] served in the armed forces of Belnar at some point by [[3963 BBY]].<ref name="KOTOR 31" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Senatorial Search" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> a [[Unidentified Belnar Senator|Republic senator]] from Belnar went missing along with an ancient [[Unidentified artifact (Khil)|artifact]] of religious importance to the Khil. An individual sent a companion to Belnar to find the lost [[Senator/Legends|senator]]. Upon doing so, the companion tricked the senator into confessing that he had the artifact in his possession, and the item was subsequently returned to the grateful Khil.<ref name="Senatorial Search">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Senatorial Search}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

===From the Republic to the Empire===
The [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] and exploration [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' visited Belnar in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] on a shakedown cruise through the territory of the Galactic Republic.<ref name="TEA" /> [[Greldo Farnor]], a Khil [[Gender/Legends|male]] who would go on to be a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] parts [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] living on<ref name="WbC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on Belnar<ref name="WbC" /> in [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="Date Farnor">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Wanted by Cracken'' translate to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. Since ''Wanted by Cracken'' gives [[Greldo Farnor]]'s age as 32, he must have been [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].</ref> During the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Third Mid Rim Army|Third Army]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] was tasked with defending Belnar's vicinity against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="EGTW" />

By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Belnar was controlled by the Galactic Empire.<ref name="EGTW" /> The Khil worlds were assigned Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governors]] but looked to their former leaders for guidance, and Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] stationed on Khil worlds remained wary of the general populace due to the Khil viewing the Empire as oppressive.<ref name="GG12" /> At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the Khil tactician and [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Tarlo Ganar]] led the [[Belnar Sector Force]] to victory over its inter-[[Star system/Legends|system]] rivals, the [[Peltsic League]], in many [[Skirmishes in Belnar space|skirmishes]] that took place in Belnar space.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> Following the Empire's [[Battle of Endor/Legends|fragmentation]]<ref name="UAA" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the Khil living on Belnar and elsewhere became one of the first members of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="UAA" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Khil}}
[[File:Xamar_Vindication_Part_1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Belnar was the homeworld of the Khil species.]]
Belnar was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Khil, a species of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="KOTORCG" /> [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. The Khil [[Diet/Legends|fed]] themselves by filtering organic particles, such as dust, microbes, [[Bacteria/Legends|bacteria]], or [[Microscope/Legends|microscopic]] [[Protein/Legends|proteins]], from the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] through the use of organs named [[hullepi]].<ref name="GG12" /> The Khil spoke the [[Khilese]] [[Language/Legends|language]] and made up 98 percent of the planet's population. The rest of Belnar's inhabitants were off-worlders of various other species whom the Khil welcomed to their peaceful planet.<ref name="KOTORCG" /> The population of Belnar around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered from 100 billion to 500 billion.<ref name="TEA" />

The residents of Belnar governed themselves via colonial [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]]. While no particular goods were imported on Belnar, the planet exported luxury items to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The Khil were also avid settlers, establishing colonies<ref name="KOTORCG" /> both in [[Star/Legends|star]] systems neighboring Belnar and on many other worlds throughout the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="GG12" /> Despite the peace-loving nature of the Khil, they displayed deviousness and vindictiveness when defending Belnar and their colonies against potential invaders,<ref name="KOTORCG" /> and every Khil, including [[Jedi/Legends|members]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], was expected to serve in the planet's armed forces.<ref name="KOTOR 31" />

==Locations==
The Khil had developed large [[City/Legends|cities]] on Belnar, with [[Belnar City]] serving as the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]].<ref name="KOTORCG" /> The technology and architecture of Khil cities on Belnar and elsewhere was heavily influenced by the fashion of the Galactic Republic member planets in the Core Worlds, although in the Khil settlements there were blocks of marshy parks between buildings, and each of the residences in affluent Khil neighborhoods had its own pond or swamp.<ref name="GG12" />

Both the Khil and members of many other species found the [[Color/Legends|green]] spaces aesthetically pleasing, and they also served as convenient places for the Khil to draw nourishment from.<ref name="GG12" /> The territories of Belnar located outside the urban centers remained untouched by the progress of the Khil. Off-world [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologists]] carried out numerous research expeditions to the swamps of Belnar.<ref name="KOTORCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Belnar was first mentioned in the [[1993]] sourcebook [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], written by [[Louis J. Prosperi]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="WbC" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the planet in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA" /> Belnar was subsequently mentioned in a Treasure Hunting Crew Skill mission of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Senatorial Search" />
